title: Holonomies and Boundary Symmetries in the Discrete Warped Chern-Simons Gravity
summary: We investigate a discrete warped Chern-Simons description of three-dimensional warped gravity based on boundary holonomies and monodromy sectors. Starting from the lower-spin SL(2, R) + U(1) gauge structure associated with warped AdS(3) holography and warped conformal field theories (WCFTs), we construct a discrete boundary framework in which ordered products of link holonomies replace continuous gauge connections along noncontractible cycles.
